verification_commands.ac1:
set -u
test -f README.md || { echo "ac1 RED: README.md missing - run the fence from the checkout root"; exit 1; }
T=$(tr -d '\r' < README.md)
O=$(printf "%s\n" "$T" | awk '/^## Online demo[[:space:]]*$/{f=1;next} f&&/^## /{exit} f')
[ -n "$O" ] || { echo "ac1 RED: no ## Online demo section - the section is rewritten in place, never removed"; exit 1; }
# (1) the stale premise is gone from the WHOLE file (three occurrences at survey base)
if printf "%s\n" "$T" | grep -qiE "only once this milestone|static-serving fix is deployed"; then
  echo "ac1 RED: a 'only once this milestone's static-serving fix is deployed' sentence survives somewhere in README.md - the fix shipped in phase_19 and was verified on the live host on 2026-10-22 (WAL 1265), so the clause is now a lie about the product"; exit 1
fi
echo "ac1 evidence: zero 'only once ... deployed' / 'static-serving fix is deployed' sentences remain anywhere in README.md (base had 3: Online demo, Live-verification step 1, Deployment on Render)"
# (2) the hosted URL sits on its OWN line, not buried in prose
HIT=$(printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -cE "^[[:space:]]*(Try |Open |Visit )?https://expense-tracker-dashboard-1qtu[.]onrender[.]com/?[[:space:]]*$")
[ "${HIT:-0}" -ge 1 ] || { echo "ac1 RED: the hosted URL is still buried inside a prose line - the operator ruling requires the address on a line of its own so a reader can copy it in three seconds"; exit 1; }
echo "ac1 evidence: the -1qtu hosted address appears on at least one line by itself"
# (3) hosted path is presented BEFORE the local seeded path
HL=$(printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -nE "expense-tracker-dashboard-1qtu[.]onrender[.]com" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
SL=$(printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -nE "npm run seed:demo" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
[ -n "$HL" ] || { echo "ac1 RED: no hosted address in the section"; exit 1; }
[ -n "$SL" ] || { echo "ac1 RED: the section lost the local seeded demo path entirely - npm run seed:demo stays the documented local demo route"; exit 1; }
[ "$HL" -lt "$SL" ] || { echo "ac1 RED: the local seeded path (line $SL) is presented before the hosted URL (line $HL) - the section must lead with what a reader can see without building anything"; exit 1; }
echo "ac1 evidence: hosted URL at section line $HL precedes the seeded local path at line $SL"
# (4) honesty about the hosted account and the cold start
printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -qiE "register your own|no seeded demo account|create (your own|an account)" || { echo "ac1 RED: the section no longer says the hosted app has no seeded account and that a visitor must register their own - implying a hosted demo login is a FAIL"; exit 1; }
printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -qiE "cold start|idle|sleeps|wakes" || { echo "ac1 RED: the section promises an instant demo without the honest free-tier cold-start note - the first visit can take tens of seconds and the reader must be told"; exit 1; }
echo "ac1 evidence: the hosted region states register-your-own-account and the cold-start reality"
# (5) the seeded local path is honest about its preconditions and about where uv comes from
printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -qiE "Prerequisites" || { echo "ac1 RED: the seeded local path no longer names ## Prerequisites as its precondition - npm run seed:demo run before the toolchain exists fails with 'uv is not recognized'"; exit 1; }
printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -qiE "Quick Start[^.]{0,160}(step[[:space:]]*1|1[[:space:]]*(to|-)[[:space:]]*3)|steps? 1[[:space:]]*(to|-|and)[[:space:]]*3" || { echo "ac1 RED: the seeded local path does not state Quick Start steps 1-3 as a precondition - that is the exact ordering defect the operator reported"; exit 1; }
printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -qiE "uv[^.]{0,120}(Quick Start|step|setup:local|install|Prerequisites|comes from)" || { echo "ac1 RED: the section never says WHERE uv comes from - the failure the operator hit is uv missing, and the fix is telling the reader that uv is used by, not installed by, the Quick Start steps"; exit 1; }
echo "ac1 evidence: the seeded local path states Prerequisites + Quick Start steps 1-3 as its precondition and explains uv's provenance"
# (6) carried tokens that stored legs depend on must survive the rewrite
for tok in "demo@example.com" "npm run seed:demo" "NO seeded demo account"; do
  printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -qF "$tok" || { echo "ac1 RED: the rewrite lost the carried token '$tok' - tests[237] seeds that account and tests[255]/t94's honesty legs grep the hosted-account statement"; exit 1; }
done
echo "ac1 evidence: the carried token set (fixed local demo account, seed command, no-hosted-account statement) survives"
# (7) NEGATIVE CONTROL: the fence must refuse a section that keeps the stale premise
SYN=$(printf '%s\n' '## Online demo' '' 'https://expense-tracker-dashboard-1qtu.onrender.com' '' 'Try it. Cold start applies. Register your own account; there is NO seeded demo account.' 'Run npm run seed:demo after Prerequisites and Quick Start steps 1-3 (uv comes from those steps, not from this repo) with demo@example.com.')
SYNT=$(printf "%s\n" "$T" | sed '/^## Online demo$/,/^## Quick Start$/d')
SYNALL=$(printf "%s\n%s" "$SYNT" "$SYN")
NC=0
printf "%s\n" "$SYNALL" | grep -qiE "only once this milestone|static-serving fix is deployed" || NC=$((NC+1))
printf "%s\n" "$SYN" | grep -qiE "register your own|no seeded demo account" && NC=$((NC+1))
printf "%s\n" "$SYN" | grep -qiE "cold start" && NC=$((NC+1))
[ "$NC" -eq 2 ] || { echo "ac1 RED: NEGATIVE CONTROL FAILED - the stale-sentence leg accepted a synthetic conforming section (scored $NC of 2), so the leg above is vacuous"; exit 1; }
echo "ac1 GREEN: ONLINE DEMO REWRITTEN - hosted URL on its own line and first, honest cold start, register-your-own-account, the seeded local path gated on Prerequisites + Quick Start steps 1-3 with uv's provenance named, every carried token intact, and all three stale static-serving sentences gone (negative control refused)"
verification_commands.ac6:
set -u
test -f README.md || { echo "ac6 RED: README.md missing"; exit 1; }
if ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ac6 GREEN: delta purity skipped - not a git worktree (the verifier runs this fence on the merge candidate where it bites)"
  exit 0
fi
CHANGED=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } 2>/dev/null | sort -u )
BAD=""
for f in $CHANGED; do
  case "$f" in
    README.md|backend/scripts/docs_verification.py|docs/criteria/docs_verification.md|docs/state/outputs/t111_definer_gate_amendment.json|docs/issues/t111.md|docs/issues/groom/t111.md|docs/state/outputs/t111_*.json) : ;;
    node_modules|*/node_modules|node_modules/*|scratch|scratch/*|build|build/*|docs/state/history|docs/state/history/*) : ;;
    *) BAD="$BAD $f" ;;
  esac
done
[ -z "${BAD// /}" ] || { echo "ac6 RED: delta purity broken - paths changed beyond README.md, the two pin constants, the regenerated report and the t111 records:$BAD"; exit 1; }
echo "ac6 evidence: every changed path is inside the t111 owned surface"
if git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -qx "backend/scripts/docs_verification.py"; then
  DIFFLINES=$(git diff -U0 HEAD -- backend/scripts/docs_verification.py | grep -E "^[+-][^+-]" | wc -l | tr -d " ")
  [ "$DIFFLINES" = "8" ] || { echo "ac6 RED: docs_verification.py changed on $DIFFLINES +/- lines, not the 8 of the four replace-only pin constants (README_DIGEST + README_LINES + the two CARRIED_DIGESTS values; 4 removed, 4 added) - INDEX_ANCHORS is rotated by the orchestrator in t119's window and the register lists and live_check are other cards' surface"; exit 1; }
  echo "ac6 evidence: docs_verification.py moved on exactly the four pin constants (2 README + 2 CARRIED), all replace-only - the 13-hex-literal count is unchanged (ac2)"
fi
for p in backend/app backend/tests frontend/src e2e ops observability incident-response docs/requirements docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md docs/criteria/req_coverage_verification.md docs/criteria/scoring_map docs/plan.md docs/backlog.md AGENTS.md render.yaml openapi.yaml .github; do
  CH=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- "$p" | grep -c .)
  UT=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -c .)
  [ $((CH + UT)) -eq 0 ] || { echo "ac6 RED: $p carries $CH tracked and $UT untracked changed files - t111 writes README prose, the two pin constants and its own records, and NOTHING else (zero product bytes, zero scoring_map bytes, zero workflow bytes)"; exit 1; }
done
echo "ac6 evidence: zero bytes under the product tree, the workflows directory, docs/criteria/scoring_map, plan, backlog, AGENTS.md, render.yaml and openapi.yaml"
# NEGATIVE CONTROL: the fence's own premise leg must bite
if tr -d '\r' < README.md | grep -qiE "only once this milestone|static-serving fix is deployed"; then
  echo "ac6 RED: a stale static-serving sentence is still in README.md - this card's own deliverable is not present"; exit 1
fi
printf 'only once this milestone%ss static-serving fix is deployed\n' "'" > build_t111_nc.tmp 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p build/t111nc; mv build_t111_nc.tmp build/t111nc/ 2>/dev/null; }
NCFILE=$(ls build/t111nc/build_t111_nc.tmp 2>/dev/null || echo build_t111_nc.tmp)
NC=$(grep -ciE "only once this milestone|static-serving fix is deployed" "$NCFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
[ "${NC:-0}" -ge 1 ] || { echo "ac6 RED: NEGATIVE CONTROL FAILED - the stale-sentence detector accepted a file that does contain the sentence, so the leg above is inert"; rm -rf build/t111nc build_t111_nc.tmp; exit 1; }
rm -rf build/t111nc build_t111_nc.tmp
echo "ac6 GREEN: DELTA PURITY AND BITE - the delta is README prose plus the two measured pin constants plus the regenerated report plus t111's own records; the product tree, the workflows directory, the scoring map, plan, backlog and both frozen yaml surfaces carry zero bytes; and the stale-sentence detector demonstrably refuses a file that still contains the sentence"
